integrity: The full mathematical argument is given in RESULT.md, with finite exact-arithmetic replay in verify_clock.py. The finite checks do not prove all-horizon identities. Mathematical originality is assessed relative to actually inspected sources and database searches, not certified independently.
scientific_limitations: Exact statistics apply to normalized arclength on a fixed one-dimensional necktie first-return fiber, not to full billiard phase-space area or metric flight lengths. Original conjugacy and branchwise return times belong to the cited primary source. The new proof uses dyadic residue counting, with possible unindexed arithmetic analogues. Results concern map iterations, not physical path distance.
title: Exact dyadic-block collision clocks and rare staircases in the necktie symplectic billiard
